_note: pl2 PqOperationeel. A ticket's category is a code (afval, websiteaanvraag); the categories a tenant uses are its own data, so they live as ticketCategory objects that name each code. Charts and lists read the name by the code (groupBy.reference.keyField). A code with no entry still shows as the code.

ticketCategory.title: Ticket category
ticketCategory.summary: A category a ticket can carry, with the name people read.
ticketCategory.description: The vocabulary for a ticket's category. A ticket holds the category's key; this object gives that key a name and an optional description. Each tenant keeps its own list.

key.title: Key
key.description: The code a ticket stores in its category field, such as afval.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name people read, such as Waste and containers.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether new tickets can still get this category.
